B0DLLQR3K7.title: Tapo Smart Plug, Wi-Fi in-Wall Outlet, P210M, Matter Compatible
bullets: 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐭𝐞 𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐒𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐇𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐚𝐧 𝐢𝐧-𝐰𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐨𝐮𝐭𝐥𝐞𝐭: Control 2 devices independently or simultaneously from anywhere using the Tapo app. Enjoy all the features and benefits of a Tapo smart plug, doubled. Requires neutral wiring and 2.4GHz Wi-Fi for setup.

𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫-𝐂𝐞𝐫𝐭𝐢𝐟𝐢𝐞𝐝: Matter-certified devices, regardless of brand, can work together and are compatible with most major smart home platforms like Amazon Alexa, Apple HomeKit, Google Home, and Samsung SmartThings. Enjoy more flexible and unified control.
𝐄𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐠𝐲 𝐌𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠: Track energy usage of connected devices, such as TVs and space heaters, and make eco-conscious adjustments to save money on energy bills.
𝐎𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐠𝐞 𝐏𝐫𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: P210M automatically turns off when devices are fully charged. Prolong the battery lifespan of your phone, tablet, and other devices.
𝐇𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐬-𝐅𝐫𝐞𝐞 𝐕𝐨𝐢𝐜𝐞 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐥: Easily control your smart outlets with voice commands via Alexa, Siri, Google Assistant, or Samsung Bixby.
𝐄𝐧𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞𝐝 𝐃𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 & 𝐋𝐨𝐚𝐝 𝐂𝐚𝐩𝐚𝐜𝐢𝐭𝐲: Tapo P210M offers improved durability and load capacity, preventing relay contact welding, a common cause of smart plug failures, and is ETL certified.

𝐓𝐚𝐩𝐨 𝐀𝐩𝐩 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐒𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐥𝐬: Instantly turn connected devices on/off from anywhere, set custom schedules, and create smart actions with other paired devices like smart switches. Perfect for busy professionals and parents.
𝐋𝐨𝐜𝐚𝐥 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐥 𝐖𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐖𝐢-𝐅𝐢: Control your connected devices through the Tapo app, even when your home’s internet is down.
𝐃𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐁𝐮𝐫𝐠𝐥𝐚𝐫𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐀𝐰𝐚𝐲 𝐌𝐨𝐝𝐞: Randomly turn lights on and off to mimic occupancy, enhancing home security while you're away.

B0G63TQFV7.title: InvisOutlet Aura in-Wall Smart Outlet with RGB Night Light, Matter Smart Outlet, 15A Dual Receptacles, Apple Home, Alexa, Google Home, SmartThings, MQTT, ETL Listed, No Hub
bullets: Flush Smart Outlet with RGB Night Light - Upgrade from bulky plug-in smart plugs to a clean in-wall smart outlet with a built-in RGB glow for hallways, bathrooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and living spaces.
Visual Smart Home Notifications - Use Aura as more than a nightlight: set it to glow red when a door is left open, blue when laundry is done, or warm white for soft nighttime guidance.
Matter Compatible, No Hub Required - Works with Apple Home, Alexa, Google Home, Samsung SmartThings, Home Assistant, and MQTT, giving smart-home users flexible local control across major platforms.

Magic Touch Sensors & Customizable Scenes - The faceplate features two high-sensitivity Magic Touch pads, acting as built-in smart switches. Configure them to toggle power, cycle lighting colors, or trigger complex "Goodnight" or "Movie Night" scenes. Gain instant manual control at the wall without needing your phone or voice commands.
DIY-Friendly In-Wall Installation - Includes WAGO connectors, tamper-resistant receptacles, ETL listing, and a slim 34.8 mm profile for standard electrical boxes. Neutral wire required.

B0CPLKGMQ3.title: Matter Smart in-Wall Outlet, Apple&Google Home, Alexa, 2.4Ghz 15A, 4Pack
bullets: Multi-compatibility: With Matter, users are no longer restricted to a specific platform and can be used with all certified smart home platforms, such as Apple Home, Amazon Alexa, Google Home, and Samsung SmartThings.
Voice control: Works with Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant, Siri, just give voice commands to Alexa or Google Assistant to control home appliances with the smart power strip. No hub required.
Remote control: No matter where you are, you can use the Matter certified app to turn on electronic devices before you get home and turn them off after you leave.

Timers and schedules: Set timers and schedules for devices such as coffee machines, lights, fans, humidifiers, holiday lights, etc. Automatically turn off devices after the set time to easily reduce energy use.

Easy setup: After powering on, open the smart life app, then scan the QR code on the smart socket and connect to your 2.4GHz WiFi network to quickly and easily integrate into your home network and enjoy smart home life.
